text:
3. 1. 10

Aticārīsuttaṃ

289. pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. Katamehi pañcahi: assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottāpī ca hoti, aticārī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
